title: Funded PhD Position at the University of Rhode Island–Join the PLaCES Lab
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated graduate student for a funded graduate research assistantship through the Environmental and Earth Science Ph.D. program at the University of Rhode Island (EVES URI), starting in Fall 2027. The student will join the PLaCES Lab (People, Land, Community and Earth Systems Science) in the Department of Earth Science, Planning and Design. The lab studies interactions between humans and the environment, with emphasis on multiple ways of knowing, being, and relating, and current projects embed CARE principles, data governance, and community-led efforts: land engagements, arts-science connections, Indigenous ways of knowing in Earth science, and open education and open science.

The assistantship includes a competitive stipend, full tuition waiver, health and dental insurance, and conference funding, with three years of full support based on performance. Qualifications: a BS in Earth sciences (geology, geography, or environmental sciences), education, psychology, or a similar field. Desired: an M.S. or M.A. in a related field, and experience with community-based research or community organizations.

To apply, email your CV to Dr. Carolina Michel (carolina.michel@uri.edu). Applications for Fall 2027 admission are due December 15, 2026; see the URI application checklist. Fee waivers are available; contact Dr. Michel with questions.
